1477-4009-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-4009-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Mox Opal, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2301-4279-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

225-1021-5411-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5485-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5485-8201.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4247-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

277-3129-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

549-1274-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-1274-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1394-1887-2060-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Vorinclex.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Vorinclex.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-1669-6754.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-6754.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

1978-2750-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Avatar Kyoshi to become an artifact.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.

654-1231-6644-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1495-6593-6774.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Loading Zone.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-6593-6774.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

4053-4211-4740-6613.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if you've cast two or more spells this turn, 5 if you've cast one spell this turn, or 7 otherwise.
4053-4211-4740-6613.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0} and 3 life. It will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Tormod's Crypt, and it will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling an opponent's graveyard
Repeat

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5042-5567-5686--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5042-5567-5686--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5256-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
5256-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5256-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

643-2438-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-2438-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

478-804-2821-3007-6071.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3007-6071.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
478-804-2821-3007-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
478-804-2821-3007-6071.description:
Animate Candelabra using Toymaker.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and The Core.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1636-3389.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {W}{W}.
1170-1636-3389.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Cast Flickering Ward by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4636-5391-5392.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Era of Innovation trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Robot, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Era of Innovation trigger, causing you to pay {1} to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may forego sacrificing the Robots.

1963-3266-4550-5289.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
1963-3266-4550-5289.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kavu Lair and Garruk's Packleader trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

759-1371-4624.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is equal to or greater than 2^X, where X is the number of opponents you have.
759-1371-4624.description:
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Revenge.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Revenge, causing the opponent to lose life equal to their life total, and causing a different player to lose half their life total, rounded up.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent's copy of Revenge.

2302-3108-3374-4659-5158.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, targeting another creature.
Repeat until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Grim Poppet persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Grim Poppet, adding {C}{C}.
Grim Poppet dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of four -1/-1 counters on it.
Repeat.

283-4289-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Soliton.
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
283-4289-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Soliton's ability.
Resolve the copy of Soliton's ability, untapping it.
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
 Resolve Soliton's ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

301-317-4050.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
301-317-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding one mana of any color.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability and Mazirek.
Resolve the Putrid Goblin trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

436-1887-4050-5003-5296.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ao, adding one mana of any color.
Ao dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Ao trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature and Vehicle you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ao from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

510-3359-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin, adding one mana of any color.
Mistmoon Griffin dies, triggering itself and Hofri Ghostforge.
Resolve the Hofri Ghostforge trigger, exiling Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Mistmoon Griffin that has "When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to your graveyard".
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Mistmoon Griffin token, adding one mana of any color.
The Mistmoon Griffin token dies, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin token's trigger granted by Hofri Ghostforge, returning Mistmoon Griffin from exile to your graveyard.
Resolve the other Mistmoon Griffin trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
